title: Data for: UAV mission planning for large-scale scanning of GNSS-degraded environments: a systematic review
description: Search strings, title/abstract screening decisions, full-text eligibility decisions with reasons, and coding of the 111 articles of the final set of a PRISMA 2020 systematic review on UAV mission planning for large-scale scanning of GNSS-degraded (under-canopy forest and urban) environments.
